definitions: The system of statistics that measures the economic activity of a country, including gross domestic product (GDP), gross national product (GNP), and national income.
A set of macroeconomic accounts that provide a comprehensive statistical picture of the economic activity of a country over a given period.
examples: The government uses National Accounts data to formulate economic policy.
Understanding National Accounts is crucial for economic analysis.
The latest National Accounts report showed a decline in investment.
